name: Glyphs of Summoning
summary: In Orgrimmar, apprentice warlocks use the Glyphs of Summoning to call a voidwalker. Transcribed from the ancient Tablet of Verga, the inscriptions draw one from the Nether into a summoning circle and bind it to the warlock’s service.

sections.title: A Pact Forged in Shadow
sections.body: In the Cleft of Shadow, warlocks study the dark arts far from the prying eyes of the Warchief’s guards. For an aspiring warlock learning from Gan'rul Bloodeye, commanding a voidwalker marks an important step. The Glyphs of Summoning come from knowledge inscribed on the Tablet of Verga, and bridge Azeroth and the Nether. In Neeru Fireblade's tent, the warlock lays them within a summoning circle. They open a threshold and draw a creature of the Void into the mortal realm. Before Gan'rul teaches the final methods of binding, the warlock must defeat the summoned creature in combat.

faq.q: What are the Glyphs of Summoning used for?
aliases: what do glyphs of summoning do
how to use glyphs of summoning
faq.answer: The glyphs are ritual writings used in the summoning circle inside Neeru Fireblade's tent in Orgrimmar. They call a hostile voidwalker from the Nether, which the warlock must subdue to master its summoning.

faq.q: Where do the Glyphs of Summoning come from?
aliases: where to get glyphs of summoning
faq.answer: Gan'rul Bloodeye, the warlock trainer in the Cleft of Shadow, provides them. They draw on knowledge preserved on the Tablet of Verga.

faq.q: Where is the summoning ritual performed?
faq.answer: The ritual takes place inside Neeru Fireblade's tent, across the cavern floor in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.

faq.q: Why do warlocks have to defeat the summoned creature?
faq.answer: A warlock must establish dominance to control a demon or creature of the Void safely. Defeating the summoned creature proves the warlock's resolve, allowing Gan'rul Bloodeye to teach how to bind its kind to their will.

angles.text: As a Horde warlock, you face an essential rite of passage. The glyphs let you prove your mastery over the Void and claim a voidwalker servant.
